title: Coordinate swap commutes with role swap on leaf rectangles
statement: Let $p$ be a deterministic communication protocol over input types $X$ (Alice) and $Y$ (Bob), and let $A \subseteq X$ and $B \subseteq Y$. Denote by $p^{\mathrm{sw}}$ the role-swapped protocol over $Y \times X$ obtained by exchanging Alice and Bob throughout, and for a set $R \subseteq X \times Y$ write $R^{\mathrm{sw}} = \{(y,x) \mid (x,y) \in R\} \subseteq Y \times X$ for its coordinate swap. Then for every rectangle $R$ in the collection of auxiliary leaf rectangles of $p$ relative to $A \times B$, the swapped set $R^{\mathrm{sw}}$ belongs to the collection of auxiliary leaf rectangles of $p^{\mathrm{sw}}$ relative to $B \times A$.
hypotheses_covered: p is a protocol over X, Y with output type α
A ⊆ X and B ⊆ Y are the constraint sets
R is a member of the auxiliary leaf rectangles of p relative to A, B
replaced:
If $R \in \texttt{leafRectanglesAux}(p, A, B)$, then
$\texttt{swapInputSet}(R) \in \texttt{leafRectanglesAux}(p.\texttt{swap}, B, A)$.
This is an internal auxiliary result proved by structural induction on the protocol.
